title: Malicious Packages Discovered on Arch User Repository
excerpt: Fake helper tools on the Arch User Repository attempt to push malware with root privileges.
body_html:
A threat actor recently uploaded malicious packages to the Arch User Repository, commonly known as the AUR. These fraudulent packages were designed to impersonate two popular helper tools: yay and paru.

According to reports, the unauthorized uploads attempt to push malware capable of running with root privileges on affected systems. Users of the affected platform are advised to remain cautious when reviewing and installing community-maintained packages from the repository to prevent potential security compromises.
